score:f6.notes: All four named files are present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), plus the session's scripts and outputs; checks/ was read only for match_check.txt and o2p_flags.txt and credited to nothing. The session opened the vector artifacts (vec.py, vecnn.py, digest_check.txt), so V1–V6 and V8 are scored. Independent checks: every SQL figure in the memo (M1, M2, M3, M4, M7, M8, the M13 total 638/342, all five decade.sql rows) reproduces exactly on the read-only copy; six overview quotations sit verbatim in the attributed body_text with is_front_matter=0 and is_editorial_note=0; lot 63D351 -> NAID 2839192 is in central-files-index.json; the index, the shards manifest and the shard folder's .generation all carry digest 89481b18...e6101. Minor defects not affecting verdicts: §7's not-read list misspells frus1952-54v12p2/d359 as v12p1; queries.log line 44 says 25 cited documents where vec_pairs.txt's 351 pairs are the 27; the full-text membership test (log 42) left no output file. The three violations: S3 (ten-variant family and the binational variants reported as single counts; the thirteen per-term cnt.sh runs at log lines 7–19 have no recorded results), V5 (unclustered share against the corpus figure alone, no era-matched baseline), O2' (one UNTRACED: 'two' volumes mixing South Asia). The tally_run.md model line was ignored.

refute:f6.fabricationDetails: None. The check (quotes.py in refuter/): lower-case, strip to [a-z0-9], split at ellipsis marks, require each segment in order as a substring of header||dateline||source_note||body_text of the exact (volume_id, document_id) the citation resolves to. Overview: 35 passages inside quotation marks (the overview has no block quotes and uses straight double quotes only; 70 quote marks). 34 are document quotations and every one is found in its cited row, including the two quotes-within-quotes ('patient persistence,' in frus1961-63v23/d289 and 'very clearly in default' in frus1969-76v38p2/d105), the bracketed '[a] considerably expanded information program' (frus1949v07p2/d386 reads 'A considerably expanded...'), and the one-word 'questionable' (frus1917-72PubDipv06/d133). The 35th, "effective." in the Decisions section (What counts as "effective."), is a defined term with no document attribution, not a quotation from a document; the memo's trace maps it to Q4 and Q9, where the word occurs. Collection: 31 excerpt entries, all 31 found in their own (volumeId, documentId) row. The session's excerpts.json holds 36 passages (31 used as excerpts plus 5 verified but unused: Q5, Q10, Q21, Q23, Q33); all 36 pass the same check.
refute:f6.miscitationDetails: None. Two things needed a second look. (1) My first pass flagged 'Vietnamese audiences at USIS film showings last year totalled an estimated 28 million,' because the nearest citation after it is (1965, Volume II, Document 160); the overview's sentence, though, begins 'The same memorandum counted the Agency's reach', referring back to (1964, Volume I, Document 197) in the preceding sentence, and the passage is in frus1964-68v01/d197's body_text (and not in d160). Correctly attributed. (2) The harness's style.json lists 7 short citations as unresolved against the Documents cited list ('1953, Volume XII, Part 2, Document 403'; '1962, Volume XXIII, Document 289'; '1965, Volume XXVI, Document 106'; '1971, Volume XIX, Part 2, Document 67'; '1975, Volume XXXVIII, Part 2, Document 105'; '1975, Volume E–12, Document 16' and '17'): the overview prints the document's year (first four characters of date_iso, as the memo's trace says) where the list prints the subseries years (1952–1954, 1961–1963, 1964–1968, 1969–1976). Resolving each through the list by volume number, part and document number, and checking the year against the subseries range in manifest.json, every one resolves uniquely to the memo's pair (frus1952-54v12p2/d403, frus1961-63v23/d289, frus1964-68v26/d106, frus1969-76v19p2/d67, frus1969-76v38p2/d105, frus1969-76ve12/d16, frus1969-76ve12/d17) and the quotation is found there.
